# Status vocabulary

Every Kit card carries one status. The test for a status is evidence, not intent: what the repository holds today (code, tests, a published version), not what is planned.

## stable

The API is frozen, with a versioning promise.

No Kit has this status today.

## pre-release

Published, and depended on by products. The API is settling but not frozen.

Kits with this status: [Fabric Kit](fabric-kit.md), [Message Kit](message-kit.md).

## alpha

Real code and tests exist, but the API is not stable. Expect it to change.

Kits with this status: [Inference Kit](inference-kit.md), [Manifest Kit](manifest-kit.md), [Spec Kit](spec-kit.md), [Identity Kit](identity-kit.md), [Service Kit](service-kit.md), [Storage Kit](storage-kit.md), [Substrate Kit](substrate-kit.md), [Interface Kit](interface-kit.md), [Venue Kit](venue-kit.md), [Mold Kit](mold-kit.md), [Stash Kit](stash-kit.md).

## scaffold

A skeleton of code that nothing depends on yet.

No Kit has this status today.

## design

A document. There is no code to speak of yet.

Kits with this status: [Platform Kit](platform-kit.md), [Device Kit](device-kit.md), [Score Kit](score-kit.md), [App Store Kit](app-store-kit.md).

## banked

Deliberately paused, together with the program it belonged to. Not abandoned, but not being worked on.

Kits with this status: [Thunderhead Kit](thunderhead-kit.md).

## legacy

Archived or retired. Kept in the catalog for the record; do not build new things on it.

Kits with this status: [Design Kit](design-kit.md).
